title: Babylonian Talmud, Sanhedrin 38b and 98a (William Davidson Edition) — Sefaria

verification_log.method: Fetched both pages through the Sefaria API

98a: R. Alexandri for R. Joshua b. Levi reconciles Dan 7:13 (clouds of heaven) and Zech 9:9 (on a donkey) — the Messiah comes with the clouds if Israel merits it; 38b: R. Akiva, "one throne is for Him and one throne is for David", disputed by R. Yose (thrones for judgment and righteousness)
